headline: Chase Sapphire Preferred's 100,000-Point Offer Returns: A Top-Tier Travel Card Bonus
reasoning: This topic scores highly due to its direct relevance to points & miles strategy and significant reader value, offering a rare and highly lucrative credit card bonus for travel.
